contexts.text: A pit of salt () = truth vastated.
Doctrine in which there is no truth is called a pit, or well, in which there is no water. Illustrated.
The Lord is called a pit () as to Divine truth.
Those in the pit (). Explained.

Let us put him in one of the pits () = among falsities. The reason pits = falsities, is that men who have been in principles of falsity are kept for some time after death beneath the Lower Earth, until falsities have been removed from them... The places there are called pits... Beneath the Lower Earth are the places of vastation which are called pits.
The pit = the falsity which is to be vastated.
Those who go down to the pit = those who are let into vastation...
That the pit = the vastation of falsity; and, in the abstract sense, falsity. Illustrated.
They drew up Joseph out of the pit () = aid, that he should not be among falsities.
Reuben returned unto the pit () = that the faith of the. Church came to look at the falsities which are of separated faith. AC 4762.
To send forth the bound out of the pit () = those who are in vastation, and who are in temptation.
The places where the bound of the king were, were called pits. Illustrated.
That they should put me into the pit () = rejection among falsities.
They hastened him out of the pit () = the hasty rejection of such things as impeded, from the state of temptation... A pit = a state of vastation, and also of temptation. AC 5249.
The spiritual were kept in the Lower Earth, in the places there which in the Word are called pits.
The captive in the house of the pit () = him who is in the corporeal Sensuous; thus in mere thick darkness concerning truths and goods, because not even in the faculty of perceiving...
If a man shall open a pit () = if anyone shall receive falsity from another.
Or if a man shall dig a pit, [and not cover it] () = or if he himself shall invent what is false.
To fall into a pit (), when predicated of good and truth in the Natural, = to pervert. Explained, Illustrated.
As a pit = falsity, the Lord said, when He had spoken about the falsities of the Church: When the blind leads the blind, both fall into the pit (). To fall into the pit = to pervert truth. AE 537:8.
The lord of the pit shall repay () = that he with whom is the falsity shall amend. AE 537:7.
The pit in which he was taken by the nations () = the falsity of evil.
The bound in the pit () = those of the Spiritual Church [who] were saved by the Advent of the Lord into the world. It is said a pit where there is no water, because water = truth. AR 884:end.
When they are being devastated they are cast into a pit with a wide bottom, where there is thick darkness...
Pits () = where truths arc; thus doctrine.
(On the state of the damned, or) bound, in the pit; and that the pit = Hell.
Those rising up were the bound from the pit.
The liberation of the bound from the pit is like childbirth, when the fetus comes to the mouth of the womb. Explained. SE 261.
That very many of the bound in the pit are ascending... Explained.
God Messiah alone sets loose the miserable ones from the pit...
Those who are [elevated] from the Lower Earth, or pit, into... Heaven. Explained.
The Gospel is preached to those only who are to be let out of the pit...
See whether the reading is fovea [or puteus].
In the Hells there are... pits as of wells, into which they descend.
Pit, and fountain = the Word as to truth.
To redeem from the pit = to deliver from damnation.
A pit in which is no water = where there is no truth. ( = doctrinals in which are no truths. AE 537:11.) AE 644:11.
The bound in the pit = those in falsities from ignorance, and yet in the desire to know truths.
Pits = the things which contain; which are doctrinals from the Word and the Word itself, in which they no longer see truths.
Pit = the Word.
To be dug out of the pit () = to be regenerated from... Divine goods. Explained.
Pit = the Word where are truths.
Pits = falsities of evil.
Pits = falsities.
Broken cisterns () = doctrinals which do not cohere...

The bound in the pit in which is no water = those in falsities from ignorance. The pit = doctrine not of truth; and also = the Lower Earth where those who were in falsities from ignorance were detained until the Advent of the Lord.
Broken cisterns which do not hold waters = doctrinals from Own intelligence, which, being from proprium, are false.
A land of a pit and of dense shade () = a state of ignorance of truth and of the derivative falsity.
Deliverance from falsities of ignorance is signified by he shall not die in the pit ().
Pit = infernal falsity; the like as well.
The pit into which Jeremiah was let down () = the truth of doctrine falsified...

(Thus) well, and pit, = the Word, and the truth of doctrine; and, in the opposite sense, the Word falsified, and the falsity of doctrine thence. In some places also the like is signified by well and pit as by fountain. References.
Pit = where are those who are in falsities of doctrine.
Pit = the Hell where such dead scientifics reign...
With those who descend to the pit () = as if in Hell.
Thou hast put me in the pit of lower things () = in the places of Hell where such are.
Those who were kept in the places called pits. Treated of.
Went down to the stones of the pit () = to the Hell where are falsities of evil.
The pit of devastation () = falsity of doctrine.
Pits = falsities of doctrine.
The Lord as to... the doctrine of truth is meant by the pit out of which they have been dug.
A land of solitude and of a pit () = a state of temptations as to the evils and falsities which emerge.
The sides of the pit are places in Hell where there are mere falsities of evil.
